title: Classifying iHRIS cadres and jobs with ISCO-08
author: Claude (session https://claude.ai/code/session_01TA4id51RCSxZ4NxijDwrWQ), for owner review

items.statement: Each deployment maps its own `cadre` and `job` codes to ISCO-08 unit groups (ValueSet isco_08_unit, system http://www.ilo.org/public/english/bureau/stat/isco/isco08/), as a ConceptMap maintained with the lists.
items.rationale: `cadre` and `job` are deployment-defined lists (iHRIS 4.3.3 ships sample data only), so the DAK cannot fix their codes. It can fix what they are classified BY. The toolkit's Plan stage names WHO's ISCO-08 classification of health workers as the standard for data sharing, and smart-base binds DAK personas to ISCO-08 (GenericPersona.iscoCode -> ISCO08ValueSet). iHRIS already ships the full ISCO-08 hierarchy (10/43/130/436 groups) and a free-text `isco` field on Qualify's cadre.

items.statement: Chain the ISCO-88 maps to ISCO-08 through the official ILO ISCO-88/ISCO-08 correspondence table.
items.rationale: iHRIS's sample jobs and classifications are keyed on ISCO-88 (48 of 51 job codes carry a verified ISCO-88 unit-group prefix; 5 of 6 classifications carry an ISCO-88 minor group). The step to ISCO-08 is many-to-many and must come from ILO's table, not from recall.
items.needs: The ILO correspondence table (e.g. the ISCO-88 to ISCO-08 index workbook) uploaded to uploads/isco/. ilo.org is egress-blocked from the building session.

items.statement: smart-base's ISCO08 CodeSystem holds 182 of ISCO-08's 619 groups while declaring `content: complete`, and includes a code `913` "Helpers in Food Preparation" that iHRIS's full ISCO-08 list does not have.
items.rationale: Measured 2026-09-22 against smart-base's own ILO workbook (182 codes, identical to its FSH): 181 codes are in both, 179 with matching titles and 2 differing only in spelling or capitalization (1113, 2265). The other 438 iHRIS codes are absent from smart-base. Whether 913 is a valid ISCO-08 minor group was NOT verified: it needs the full ILO structure.
items.needs: Check against the complete ILO ISCO-08 structure. If confirmed, report upstream to smart-base (content should be `fragment`, or the list completed; 913 corrected).
